svg.aria-label: Left: ICE lines for house price against size rise with steeper slopes for homes with a garden, with the partial dependence line in the middle. Right: ICE lines for energy use against temperature go down for heated homes and up for air-conditioned homes, so the partial dependence average is almost flat
